## Governance

- [ ] `DECISIONS.md` updated or not needed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] audit evidence updated or not needed
- [ ] agent governance contracts, schemas, fixtures, validators, and docs updated together when authority changes
- [ ] no adapters, demos, providers, deployment, or UI added unless explicitly in scope
- [ ] no live hooks, scheduled loops, external writes, merge, release, or deploy automation added without explicit scope
